summary: The supplied actual artifacts consistently support a completed, closed, 58-row, 8-batch zero-update geometry-input/derivative diagnostic. Independent artifact arithmetic passes. Original PID 901298 was live at the first scheduled observation and absent with exit 0 at the second. The raw geometry probe has a 45358.3125 gradient norm on the fresh batch labeled historical step 3211; signed-log input compression changes that norm to 0.46410974860191345 at exactly the same scalar loss. This establishes local zero-output derivative sensitivity only. It neither recreates historical step 523 nor demonstrates trained efficacy, formal accuracy or passed research gates.

A_gt_provenance.details: The active matcher uses frozen parent predictions against valid annotation targets. Targets are formed from box_label_mask, center_label, size_gts, sem_cls_label, gt_masks and annotation text maps; supervised superpoint masks are majority reductions of dataset GT masks. The data wrapper gets object boxes from scan annotations. Inference inputs contain points, text, superpoints and detector proposals/classes, without GT boxes/masks. Predicted-Mask extent_reference is model-side geometry, not substituted GT. Actual records contain exactly one parent-to-GT assignment per expression (58 in total; every target_id is 0), and each loss reports matched_queries=valid_gt=batch size. Dataset contents and unsupplied external loader/loss implementations were not independently opened in this bounded audit.

B_normalization.details: The supervised loss helper passes the actual valid-GT count to the four native loss functions and combines terms with [5,1,10,2]. Across all 24 probe records, independent scalar reconstruction differs by at most 7.543712854385376e-8 (floating-point accumulation); the four components and total loss are exactly equal across the three arms in each batch. No accuracy metric is present and no metric is divided by its own output extrema. Coarse-size division is an explicitly measured input feature operation; count normalization uses the fixed 50000 constant. Reported gradient norms are unclipped L2 measurements, reconstructed from 10 parameter norms per head to relative error at most 5.241384931721195e-8.

evidence.detail: Actual backward and raw norm measurements.

D_called_and_dead_paths.details: run_mask_support_pair imports ScaleDiagnosticRun as PairedSupportRun, instantiates it and dispatches the overridden run. The active path performs eight observed frozen-parent forwards, matching, geometry collection, three correction/loss/backward probes per batch, gradient clearing and JSON/log writes. Base __init__ creates two AdamW objects, but the inherited step, clipping, optimizer.step, checkpoint save/restore/integration, evaluate and original run methods are inactive. The log head has no optimizer. native_mask_witness and GroundingEvaluator evaluation methods are not called; importing the official evaluator is not a validation result or a new numerical native-criterion equality witness. mask_reference.reference_bounds_witness and local box_iou are also not called by this diagnostic. Observed final_semantic_head_calls=1 in each batch is a runtime receipt; the unsupplied helper implementation was not reread here.

E_scope.details: Exactly 8 selected historical batch labels [1,2,522,523,524,3211,3722,3723], batch sizes [8,8,8,8,8,8,8,2], 58 distinct training expression rows, 58 distinct stored point hashes, 8 parent forwards and 14848 candidate inputs were observed. Three identically initialized zero-output heads yield 24 loss/gradient records. One seed (2027), one fresh augmented realization, no holdout or formal validation, no trained compression branch. Row IDs are not scene IDs; physical scene count is unestablished. Panel rows/order and archived gradients exactly reconcile with all selected train.jsonl records and TRAINING_SCALE_ANALYSIS. All 3723 old log records were parsed: 29778 distinct rows, correct batch sizes, both-arm matched/GT counts and independently matching headline summary statistics. Fresh augmentation/RNG and zero-output head construction do not restore historical augmentations/Gumbel state or trained geometry weights.

F_evaluation_classification.subtype: training-panel supervised loss and zero-output local derivative diagnostic
F_evaluation_classification.details: The loss/matching uses real annotation GT; feature amplitude/floor records are tensor diagnostics rather than accuracy scores. It is not synthetic-target validation, a trained ablation, historical-spike recreation, formal benchmark evaluation, or evidence of completed research gates. Signed-log compression is only an input transformation in this controlled derivative probe.

floor_and_amplitude_evidence.floor_definition: native_coarse_size <= 1e-6; candidate count means at least one such dimension.
floor_and_amplitude_evidence.evidence_level: All 14848 per-query maxima and the 58 matched-index selections are independently reconciled; the signed-log maximum relation is checked to <1e-6 absolute error. Floor counts and per-member threshold counts are retained runtime aggregates, independently summed but not rebuilt from unretained raw tensors.
floor_and_amplitude_evidence.attribution_limit: Only batch-aggregated floor counts survive. The sole >100 matched amplitude is row 34293/query 175, and its batch also contains the sole matched floor event. Direct per-query identification of that floor event cannot be independently established from the supplied artifacts.

evidence.detail: Same raw amplitude and compressed maximum.
Row ID corresponding to the third assignment/query 175.

measured_gradient_vs_scalar_loss.interpretation: The large norm is measured by backward, not inferred from the scalar loss. At zero output weights only output-layer derivatives are nonzero. Changing the nine geometry inputs causes a much smaller local output-weight derivative on this one controlled batch, with identical masks and scalar loss; it does not establish optimization stability or trained efficacy.

evidence.detail: Zero hidden-layer gradients and output norms.

state_and_no_updates.evidence_level: Completion is written after exact mask, probe state and final parent state assertions. No raw mask/state/gradient tensors are archived in these files, so the reviewer cannot independently rerun tensor equality or autograd. The active call graph has no optimizer step/clipping/save; two unused optimizer objects are created. No new trained weights are produced by the reviewed path.
